comparison_policy.authoritative_release_decision: Original frozen benchmark metrics, query-cluster bootstrap, eight release gates, and PASS/REVIEW/FAIL policy.
comparison_policy.paired_comparison: Effect-size deltas + paired bootstrap CIs are secondary comparison evidence and do not alter release gates.
comparison_policy.win_tie_loss: Per-metric matched-query win/tie/loss counts summarize direction consistency with metric orientation applied.
comparison_policy.gate_transitions: v1-to-v2 pass/fail transitions use the same frozen release-gate definitions and do not redefine the v2 release decision.
